auth.label: Private Access Token
auth.description: WP Maps private access token sent as access_token. Generate it from Configuration > Access Token: https://wpmaps.com/help/generate-wp-maps-api-access-token/.

extraFields.label: Client ID
extraFields.description: WP Maps client ID sent as client_id. View it alongside the access token in Configuration > Access Token.

actions.name: create_products
actions.description: Create one or more products in WP Maps.

price.description: Product price as displayed by WP Maps.

images.description: Public product image URL passed to WP Maps.

categories.description: Product category value accepted by WP Maps.

tab.description: WP Maps tab assigned to the product.

additionalProperties.description: Public product URL at the retailer.

affs.description: Online retailer links keyed by retailer name.

items.description: One product to create in WP Maps.

language.description: WP Maps language code used for localized fields, such as en_US.

inputSchema.description: Products and optional language for a WP Maps create request.

anyOf.description: Product image URL or provider-defined image value.

images.description: Product image URL or provider-defined image value.

categories.description: Product categories returned by WP Maps.

items.description: A product returned by WP Maps.

results.description: Product save summary returned by WP Maps.

outputSchema.description: The WP Maps product create response.
